risks.risk: AI advice mistaken for certified protection
risks.control: Independent safety systems and human approval; no control writes.

risks.risk: Weak or imbalanced model presented as reliable
risks.control: Show held-out metrics and baseline comparison; require site evaluation.

risks.risk: Construction/lab/geothermal data generalized to oil/gas
risks.control: Label proxies; validate on approved field data.

risks.risk: Derived targets or shared wells inflate scores
risks.control: Group/temporal splits and feature leakage review.

risks.risk: Historical or stale readings presented as live
risks.control: Display source mode, capture time, quality and last successful update.

risks.risk: Drift, bad units or calibration invalidate analysis
risks.control: Unit registry, calibration records and bad-quality handling.

risks.risk: Unauthorized OT connectivity or control action
risks.control: Read-only sandbox; separate demo from OT networks.

risks.risk: Shared reviewer credentials expose client/site data
risks.control: Individual identity and site scopes before multi-client production.

risks.risk: Worker imagery or documents disclosed
risks.control: Minimize evidence and enforce retention/access rules.

risks.risk: Publisher data terms unsuitable for client use
risks.control: Review underlying rights; no blanket commercial permission claim.

risks.risk: Generated answer invents procedures or citations
risks.control: Source IDs, evidence excerpts, abstention and operator review.

risks.risk: Retrieved text attempts to override system behavior
risks.control: Treat evidence as data; no tools or operational actions from generated text.

risks.risk: Uncalibrated simulation used for decisions
risks.control: Explicit equations, assumptions, calibration and uncertainty requirements.

risks.risk: Simulated policy controls real equipment
risks.control: Simulation-only policy; no actuator integration.

risks.risk: Route demo interpreted as safe robot operation
risks.control: Synthetic no-go map; physical validation and fail-safe hardware required.

risks.risk: Survey demo lacks flight/airspace/site authorization
risks.control: No flight command; validate mission, weather and site permissions separately.

risks.risk: Missing/wrong coordinates drive response
risks.control: Validate bounds and CRS; report excluded locations and no inferred asset proximity.

risks.risk: Image masks mistaken for wall-thickness proof
risks.control: Vision is a screening proxy; engineering/NDT verification required.

risks.risk: Demo outage or resource exhaustion interrupts presentation
risks.control: Precompute reports; bounded jobs; health checks; offline fallback.

risks.risk: Metrics or client report cannot be reproduced
risks.control: Saved source hashes, model version, run ID, assumptions and review record.

risks.risk: Illustrative ROI presented as achieved savings
risks.control: Use client-approved baseline and measured pilot outcomes; no invented ROI.

risks.risk: Missing records or labels counted as compliance
risks.control: Coverage reporting; no compliance denominator without validated observations.
